description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, inside verifyRecompute, at the reconcile step that abstains with "only one derivation produced a usable measurement" (the branch after the reconcileDerivations call when reconciled.truth is null), add a bounded RESCUE clause BEFORE returning null: when _useRecipe is true AND side a (the recipe derivation) produced a non-null numeric value greater than 0 AND side b is null (it failed to produce a measurement — NOT a disagreeing value) AND the recipe is strongly proven (_recipe.agreed >= 10 && _recipe.agreed > _recipe.disagreed * 4), then set truth = a.value and continue (do not abstain). Do NOT increment the recipe's agreed counter for a rescue. Leave all other cases unchanged — a disagreeing side b still abstains, and degenerate truth (0) is never rescued. Add a console.log noting a recipe rescue occurred.
